comment: Default-FAIL verification contract. Every check started at passes=false and was flipped only after its verification command ran and the recorded evidence file was inspected. risk=medium, so the high-tier requirement-traceability check is not in the tier minimum and is absent, matching T-001's medium-tier contract in this feature. required_workflow=acceptance-first: the acceptance criteria were authored before the fixtures, and the task's own red/green logs are carried on the test-type checks. spec_revision names 51181122 -- the commit whose bytes these checks actually ran against -- rather than T-005's implementing commit daa7d35a, because the gate applied an in-gate fix to the AC-025(a) assertion under auto-fix-policy and cycle 2 reviewed the post-fix bytes. stack=shell: the deliverable is a PS5.1-safe PowerShell suite exercising a python3-stdlib shell twin and its PowerShell twin, so the three compile-oriented checks carry waiver_reason per risk-gate-matrix.md's stack descriptor. The task's declared red.log/green.log record 232 checks against the suite as T-005 left it; the gate-time acceptance-tests.log records 319 against the shipped suite, which has since grown by other tasks' review-ticket blocks. Both are retained: the first is the task's TDD evidence, the second is the gate's measurement.

checks.waiver_reason: No lint toolchain is configured for shell, python or PowerShell in this repository; .github/workflows/test.yml runs test suites only, with no linter step.
No static type checker is configured for the PowerShell suite or for the python3-stdlib shell twin it exercises.
No compile or build step; the suite and both twins are interpreted scripts with no external dependency.
No consumer is wired in Phase 0 per design.md's Deployment / CI Plan; the twins have no integration surface yet.
No runnable service or UI; this task ships test code only.
Not a refactor or bugfix task and no baseline-behavior.md exists; T-005 authors new tests over behaviour introduced earlier in the same feature.
No design-system/ directory in this repository and no UI-layer files were touched.
